interpretation.routing_overhead_claim: HaRP adds 23.9ms ± 30.2ms routing overhead per inference (p95: 66.6ms). Forward pass is paid regardless for response generation. This is the overhead added on top of standard LLM inference.
interpretation.explanation_overhead: DLA-based mechanistic explanation not yet implemented in HaRP. Will be measured in GUARDIAN project. Expected: ~30-80ms additional for 32-layer DLA at Mistral 7B scale.
interpretation.note_on_hardware: Timings on Apple Silicon MPS. GPU (A100) forward pass would be ~5-20x faster. Routing overhead (extract + features + decision) is hardware-independent after hidden states are on CPU.
